I booked a table for four at the Bistro on Fri 2026-11-13 at 19:00 under Thandi, 082 555 0147. The booking ID is b-1 and the deposit is 200 ZAR.

I didn't send anything, and the booking went through without it. The other reviews were positive, though one says parking is tight on Fridays.

I requested 50 ZAR each from sipho, lerato and anna toward the deposit. That covers 150 of the 200 ZAR, so you cover the other 50 ZAR.
